title: Stop! In the Name of Flaws: Disentangling Personal Names and Sociodemographic Attributes in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Critical literature review and methodological critique of using personal names as proxies for gender identity in NLP, highlighting issues of construct validity, systematic misgendering, and the erasure of trans and non-binary individuals.

Critical literature review examining the flaws, validity issues, and cultural insensitivity of inferring race or ethnicity from personal names, including the unequal distribution of misrecognition harms across marginalized racial groups.
Conceptual analysis of representational harms and stereotyping that occur when NLP systems associate specific names with socioeconomic classes (e.g., the name 'Kevin' in Germany).
